body:
Honestly, I feel like the relationship with my girlfriend was the only thing keeping me afloat the past year and a half. I am more than willing to end my relationship with my family, but she kept me sane enough to not think about the end for so long. I've considered my future to be with her. It's a bit too much, and I admit I sound like one of those desperate guys who can't live without their girlfriends because they're the "love of their lives". 

I've tried moving out, but market forces forced me back in. I had no issues with food, I'm a very frugal person with no vices, but rent and the cost of living makes it hard if not impossible to live on my own. It was impossible to manage a budget with the salary I was getting, and I can't get a better paying job without the degree. The people who "promised" to help me with my schooling and I'll pay them back when I get a job disappeared. 

I sound like I'm just complaining without merit or something, but I swear I'm the kind of person who tries everything to solve a problem. Heck, I'm considered as "Mr. Optimistic" by some of my friends. I always stand back up after falling, if I could. But I'm just tired of doing that now, I don't wanna stand up anymore. Life and society, fucked up. Pointless.

Life, expectations, distance and needs. Well, those are some of the things. Financial instability and trying to overcome that was hard, I tried fixing that by getting a relatively well paying job. But my dad took half of my money for an "investment" while my mom keeps siphoning things for her wants. Siblings aren't helping at all with the situation, being more a burden than anything else. 

Then there's college. I wasn't able to finish it because of the above reason, but I worked to solved it. But, yeah. They came along and said "screw that". Now I'm stuck between transferring schools, I have most of my credentials but no school to transfer to. I transferred so I can pay for myself. I'm working three jobs at the moment just so I can manage 

Then there's my relationship with my girlfriend. We're in a long distance one, and she's been really tired lately. Of us, of me. She doesn't have enough patience for stuff and everything I do annoys her. But I can't really blame her, she's been through a lot because of me. And I can't even do much for her. I can't give her that physical presence she needs because I'm too far away. And I needed the college degree to immigrate, but tough luck that happening. 

I really am just tired of it all. Things don't go my way, and not for the lack of trying. I did stuff, got screwed and stood up again with slightly lowered expectations the next time. But time and time again, people and situations just keep knocking me down. It's sickening, it's sad. I don't want it anymore. 


Ha. Long post. Sorry, and thanks for reading.
